settings.heading: We wash buildings for a living. This is the product we'd use at home.
settings.content: Soak n Go comes from Maximum Wash Ltd — a professional exterior cleaning company with around 20 staff washing houses, apartment blocks and commercial buildings across Auckland, Tauranga and Christchurch. After years of watching supermarket products under-deliver, we bottled the approach we actually trust.

settings.heading: Born on the end of a wand
settings.content:
When you wash buildings every day, you learn what actually kills moss, mould, algae and lichen — and what just moves it around for a photo. You also learn that the harshest chemical isn't the smartest one: the smartest one is the one that keeps working after the crew's gone home.

Soak n Go is that thinking in a bottle that clicks onto your garden hose. No acid, no bleach, no scrubbing, no rinsing. Soak once, walk away, and let the weather do the labour.

settings.heading: Why we bottled it
settings.content:
“I've spent years quoting building washes, and the same conversation kept happening at the front gate: 'What can I use myself between washes?' I never had a good answer — everything on the shelf was either bleach in a fancy bottle or a science project with a pump sprayer.

So we made the answer. Soak n Go is what I put on my own place. Click it on, soak it, put the hose away. The weather's going to be working on your house all year anyway — this just puts it on the payroll.”

— Bas, Maximum Wash Ltd

settings.heading: No nasty chemicals
settings.text: No acid, no bleach, no chlorine. Clean without dousing the place in bleach every spring.

settings.heading: NZ owned & made
settings.text: Formulated, bottled and shipped right here, for NZ weatherboard, NZ moss and NZ weather.

settings.heading: Professional standards
settings.text: We answer for results on other people's buildings every day. Your fence gets the same standard.

settings.heading: If it doesn't work, we'll make it right
settings.content: We know what clean looks like — and what it doesn't. If Soak n Go doesn't shift it, get in touch and we'll sort you out.
